source_edits.reason: Tessellated lettering (Blender text objects converted to mesh and joined into the piece by the script's label() helper, 6 mm thick) removed as loose parts no thicker than 6.5 mm along Y; it is cleanly separable from the bevelled boxes, the thinnest of which is 80 mm. Lettering is not shipped.

derivation.method: Import the kit FBX with Blender (file axes and FBX_SCALE_UNITS honoured: metres, Z-up); remove engine collision hulls (UCX_*) and apply the recorded edits (source_edits); remove the kit material slots (Almond materials are assigned; kit textures are not shipped); Validate mesh; weld coincident vertices; dissolve degenerates; recalculate normals; collapse decimation only when above target with validation between passes; triangulate and validate before measuring. Remove wire edges, split edges shared by more than two faces and remove zero-area faces (counts in quality.topology_repairs). Mark edges sharper than 30 degrees as sharp (flat-shaded hard edges; shading only). Never subdivide to inflate counts.

reference_review: Reviewed on 2026-11-20: procedural geometry, so there is no input image. The prepared library mesh was rendered untextured from the front three-quarter view (500 px, viewed in a 300 px contact sheet) and the script code that models it was read: no lettering, logos, brand marks or characters in the geometry. The source FBX carried tessellated lettering (the words "NEON GATEWAY" on the sign band), removed as a recorded edit (edits); the front render (600 px, viewed at 400 px) shows the panel blank.

Owner approved release in the Almond library under CC BY 4.0 on 2026-11-20 ("increase the range of models, from the ones i used for my project y2k games, (except for the operatives and bosses)") and chose the procedural kit pieces on 2026-11-20.
